test-fs-watch-close-when-destroyed.js.reason: Blocked by an rmdir-lane bug, not watch semantics: fs.rmdirSync on an existing EMPTY dir throws ERR_FS_EISDIR ('Path is a directory: rm returned EISDIR') at base 1a89d258 (verified pristine). The test's fs.rmdirSync(root) fails before any watcher assertion runs. Out of scope for the watch lane.

test-fs-watch-recursive-delete-race.js.reason: Tests Node's internal non-native watcher directly: requires --expose-internals, imports internal/fs/recursive_watch and internal/fs/watchers (kFSWatchStart), and monkey-patches fs.watch expecting the INTERNAL watcher to call it during its real-disk walk. Under the shim the internal watcher calls the real fs (importer is internal, not redirected), so the patched shim fs.watch is never invoked and deletedChild stays false (verified failing identically at base 1a89d258). A browser shim cannot reproduce Node-internal module wiring.

test-fs-watch-recursive-prefix-sibling.j.reason: Same rmdir-lane bug as above: fs.rmdirSync on the empty dir 'foo' throws ERR_FS_EISDIR at base 1a89d258 (verified pristine). Test setup fails before watcher assertions. Out of scope for the watch lane.

test-fs-watchfile-bigint.js.reason: Requires --expose-internals and deepStrictEqual of emitted stats against Node's internal BigIntStats class (require('internal/fs/utils')). Our Stats instances are structurally identical (0n fields) but assert.deepStrictEqual fails on prototype identity (Stats vs BigIntStats) — verified failing at base 1a89d258 and after the watchFile StatWatcher rewrite. A browser-first shim cannot mint instances of Node's internal classes.
